The main takeaway from our work is that
the CRN throughput is maximized when the sensing and channel access time is minimized and the channel switching time is maximized.
the jamming probability is a function of the jamming signal-to-noise ratio (JSNR) and the sensing signal-to-noise plus jamming ratio (SSNRJ).
